Inheritance

Stage 5 Concept ⏱ 15 min 📖 Glossary

Children reuse parents: Student is a Person with extras. Write shared code once in the parent.

🔎 Motivating questionWhy do younger siblings get hand-me-downs?

Objectives

  • Extend a parent class
  • Reuse with super
  • Explain single inheritance

Needs first: Static Members

1 Start with an analogy

Real life first, code second.

Family wardrobe: parent owns jackets (name, walk()). Child Student extends Person, adds grade, reuses jackets, may tailor (override later). Java: one wardrobe donor only (single inheritance).

⚠️ Where the analogy breaksWhere it breaks: hand-me-downs may not fit. Child cannot remove parent traits — only add/refine. Wrong “is-a”? Use composition.

2 The concept, plainly

One idea at a time, words before jargon.

class Student extends Person. Child gets fields/methods (non-private).

super(...) first line builds parent part. super.method() calls parent version.

Java: one parent class, many interfaces. Test: “is-a”? Student is a Person ✓.

3 Watch it move: Hand-me-downs

Step at your pace. Text explains every move.

4 Live code demo

Small, correct Java 17 (LTS) code. Read, trace, copy.

Main.javaJava 17
class Person { String name; Person(String n){ name=n; } }
class Student extends Person {
  int grade;
  Student(String n, int g){ super(n); grade=g; }
}
Student s = new Student("Ada", 90);
System.out.println(s.name + " " + s.grade);
▶ Output Ada 90
  • Student reuses name.
  • super builds parent.
  • Adds grade.
💡 Why this output?Parent part + child part assembled in order.

6 Common mistakes (at least 3)

Wrong, why, fixed — learn from realistic slips.

❌ Mistake 1: Forgetting super(...)Why: Parent unbuilt (if no no-arg).
✅ Fix: super(n); first line.
❌ Mistake 2: Book extends Library (wrong is-a)Why: Book is-not-a Library.
✅ Fix: Library has Books (composition).
❌ Mistake 3: Expecting two parentsWhy: Single class inheritance.
✅ Fix: Extend one; implement interfaces.

7 Guided practice

Hints first, solutions only after a real try.

Is-a?

Car/Engine: inheritance or not?

HintIs engine a car?
SolutionNo — composition (has-a).
Add Teacher

Teacher extends Person + subject.

HintMirror Student.
Solutionclass Teacher extends Person { String subject; ... }

8 Lesson quiz

3+ questions. Attempts saved locally; review queue learns your weak spots.

9 Takeaways + next step

  • extends reuses parent.
  • super builds parent first.
  • Use only for true is-a.
